name: mr-screen
why: The eight questions the inclusion screen was written for, and the set it may not damage. All are enumeration-shaped by the product's own classifyQuestionShape, so under an operands control they still read enumerated's bytes and the comparison is one variable. The eight are wrong by exactly -1 on 41222844945; the three over-by-one questions 13.204.4 named are recorded descriptively below and are in neither group, because a question that is already wrong cannot worsen.

reads.decisive: one side at or below one correct read, the other at or above three, out of four repetitions
reads.mixed: anything else, counted and printed but not attributed, because a 2-of-4 split is what the measured 4.8% per-read flip rate produces on its own

guard.rule: MR and enumeration-shaped by classifyQuestionShape, minus every id named in converts or descriptive; derived from the control artifact alone, so it carries no treatment information
guard.ceilingWhy: 4 is the 2-sigma band these 83 questions carry at the measured 4.8% per-read flip rate, scaled from 13.203.4's 9.3 questions on 470: 9.3 * sqrt(83/470) = 3.9. So the guard fails only on damage the reader's own churn does not explain. 61 of the 83 read 1111 on 41222844945 and 17 read 0000, and the read tool counts a question as worsened only when the control had it right, so the 17 are inert rather than generous.

descriptive.why: 13.204.4 named these as a guard and that criterion could not fail: they are already wrong in every repetition, so 'worsen' had no accessible meaning. Read as a direction only.
